say:1:1060000201:0.text: Magister, before approaching the animal, remember to ring the bell!
say:1:1060000201:0.source_cn: 主人，靠近动物之前，记得先摇动铃铛吸引它的注意力！
say:1:1060000201:0.male: Magister, before approaching the animal, remember to ring the bell!
say:1:1060000201:0.female: Magister, before approaching the animal, remember to ring the bell!

say:2:1060000202:0.text: Once it catches up, make sure to avoid those attractive things, or it'll lose focus!
say:2:1060000202:0.source_cn: 等它跟上来之后，一定要避开那些很有吸引力的东西，不然它...
say:2:1060000202:0.male: Once it catches up, make sure to avoid those attractive things, or it'll lose focus!
say:2:1060000202:0.female: Once it catches up, make sure to avoid those attractive things, or it'll lose focus!

say:5:1060000204:0.text: There doesn't seem to be any clues around here. Magister, shall we go back and ask again?
say:5:1060000204:0.source_cn: 这附近好像没有线索了，主人，我们再回去问问吧！
say:5:1060000204:0.male: There doesn't seem to be any clues around here. Magister, shall we go back and ask again?
say:5:1060000204:0.female: There doesn't seem to be any clues around here. Magister, shall we go back and ask again?

say:7:1060000203:0.text: Whoa! This is not the right direction! Let's go back!
say:7:1060000203:0.source_cn: 哇，搞错了，不是这个方向！我们赶快回去吧！
say:7:1060000203:0.male: Whoa! This is not the right direction! Let's go back!
say:7:1060000203:0.female: Whoa! This is not the right direction! Let's go back!
